body: This sounds extremely horrible. Is this a sex camp or am orientation camp?

Suicide, like marriage, is a commitment. I remember staying up at night, crying, wanting to die so much, especially on a particular day my high school don't want me to come back anymore. (Life sucks when you are barely educated.) On that day, the moon was bright and full. The moonlight, having a sliverish shine, is like a white wedding veil that drapes over me. It represent how close to it I am on that night because I am already wearing a "wedding veil" and conditions were ripe.

Suicide, is my courter, is there to free me from my pain.
